|

===Rewards===
*[[Rada's blessing 3]]:
**Unlimited teleports to the [[Kourend Woodland]]
**Three daily teleports to the top of [[Mount Karuulm]]
**6% chance to catch two [[fish]] at once anywhere when equipped, excluding at [[Tempoross]]' [[Tempoross Cove|Cove]] (no additional experience granted)
**Has a [[Prayer bonus]] of +1 when equipped, similar to the [[God blessing|god blessings]]
*[[Ash sanctifier]], claimable from [[Tyss]]
**An additional item that, when carried, causes [[Remains#Demonic ashes|demonic ashes]] dropped from killed monsters to be automatically scattered, granting half the [[Prayer]] experience that would have been granted for scattering them normally
**This item is charged with [[death rune]]s
*[[Antique lamp (hard)|Antique lamp]] worth 15,000 experience in any skill of at least level 50
*Any [[slayer helmet]] can be used in place of a [[Shayzien helm (5)]] for its [[Shayzien armour (tier 5)|protection]] against [[lizardman shaman]]s, after talking to [[Captain Cleive]] (requires having the helm in your [[collection log]])
*60% discount on [[Eodan]]'s [[tanner|tanning]] services, up from 40%
*5% increased chance to save a [[Farming#Variable crop yield|"harvest life"]] at the [[herb patch]]es in [[Hosidius]] and the [[Farming Guild]], slightly increasing your harvest yield
*[[Thirus]] offers you 40 [[dynamite]] for free every day, worth a total of {{NoCoins|{{GEP|Dynamite}}*40}} [[coins]] on the [[Grand Exchange]]
